spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Cipher housing is still cold. Index is live.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Pull the physical key. Do not slot it into anything until we control the core.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Core has two execution paths. Verify and forward, or revoke and wipe.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Preserve or burn. Morita built the moral argument into the interface so operators could call themselves technicians.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Twenty-six subject aliases. Seven completed pairs. Four marked unrecoverable.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: And one live dispatch signature. Morita touched this ledger less than an hour ago.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: The ledger carries Morita's live attestation. Preserve the route and I can follow the next handshake upstream.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: The same route carries names for every stolen identity. Leave it open and anyone with the cipher can reconstruct them again.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Burn it and Morita disappears behind the organization that paid him. We save today's couriers and guarantee replacements tomorrow.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Preserve it and the people already inside remain inventory. A future rescue does not cancel a present weapon.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: V, keep the line open. We trace Morita, copy what we need, then close it from the top.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: There is no harmless copy. Erase the index and issue the wipe. Mara keeps her life. The route loses everyone else's.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Preserve the index. We use it to find Morita.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Confirmed. Authenticate the cipher and leave the uplink intact.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Burn the index. Nobody carries these people again.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Confirmed. Revoke every package, then destroy the local key.

spoken_lines.speaker: System
spoken_lines.text: Route attested. Pair Zero-Seven verified. Next handoff pending.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Black Lantern accepted the cipher. I have Morita's next handshake.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Mara's fragments are scrubbed. The wider index is still live. That part is yours now.

spoken_lines.speaker: System
spoken_lines.text: Route revoked. Subject index purged. Package wipe issued.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Index is gone. Wipe acknowledgements are returning now.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Morita's signature just vanished. Save the signed destruction receipt. It is the only physical proof Black Lantern existed.
